inputs.commit_message: verify ASOL stage 2 with isolated dependencies
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/hesham/gova
branch=agent-request/chatgpt
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/asol-stage2-r2-XXXXXX)
cleanup() { git -C "$root" worktree remove --force "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || rm -rf "$tmp"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git -C "$root" fetch origin "$branch"
remote_sha=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse "origin/$branch")
git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$tmp" "$remote_sha"
cd "$tmp"
rm -f .agent-control/requests/asol-stage2-complete-20260901-0844.json
rm -f .agent-control/requests/asol-stage2-complete-r2-20260901-0847.json
echo STAGE2_R2_BASE_SHA=$remote_sha
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run services:sync
npm run docs:generate
npm run docs:ci
npm run runtime:check
npm run architecture:check
npm run test:notifications
npm run test:ota-core
npm run typecheck
npm run lint
npm run validate:error-logging
npm run github:ci-policy
git add -u
git add docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated 2>/dev/null || true
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git config user.name gova-local-agent
  git config user.email gova-local-agent@users.noreply.github.com
  git commit -m "fix: complete ASOL stage 2 generated gates"
  git push origin HEAD:"$branch"
fi
echo STAGE2_R2_FINAL_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo ASOL_STAGE2=PASS
